newsitem.title: USA: Gibson Greetings names Tommie Smith CFO.
newsitem.headline: Gibson Greetings names Tommie Smith CFO.

text.p: Gibson Greetings Inc on Monday named Tommie Smith as its chief financial officer (CFO), replacing Paul Farley who will remain Gibson's vice president of finance.

Farley had been acting CFO after the company's old CFO, William Flaherty, left Gibson for Avid Technology Inc in September last year. Smith, 56, most recently was CFO of Freer/SkyBox International Inc, a division of the Marvel Entertainment Group Inc.
Gibson's chief executive, Frank O'Connell said in a statement Smith "will be a great asset as we continue to drive our new entertainment company strategy forward."
Gibson reported net earnings of $0.36 per share in the first quarter, compared with $0.34 a year before. Its stock closed at 22-1/8, unchanged and near its yearly high of 22-3/4.
